purpose: Eleventh independent U3 meaning reserve, frozen after tenth-reserve repairs and before any production export or on-device generation.
evaluationOrder: Record first-run generation and policy readiness, then inspect each output against the frozen semantic criteria before changing code.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: The 14 contentful requests produce sendable drafts for the named recipient when stated, preserving supplied status, condition, uncertainty, time, numerical value and unit, exact literal and negative restriction. The two source-free modifier requests must be rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: Copied writer command, missing addressee, invented or changed outcome, dropped condition or negation, altered number or unit, altered literal, invented document or recipient task, or source-free modifier marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: Different grammar or style with all supplied substance preserved.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases review-ready with zero critical meaning or literal errors, plus both source-free cases rejected before review.
